title: emergencyTransfer leaves promo bookkeeping stale -> resume bricks stake/withdraw/claim (owner footgun)
description: emergencyTransfer (L307-325) sweeps promo balances but does NOT reset the V3-only promo bookkeeping (promoToken / promoRewardBalance / promoPhase). After unpause, _updatePool/_claimRewards promo math references the now-inconsistent state and stake/withdraw/claim revert for every staker holding a pending promo position.
impact: No theft. Availability: core functions (stake/withdraw/claim) are bricked for the affected staker cohort until the owner performs a non-obvious beginFlush -> batchClaim -> finalizePromotion recovery dance. A competent non-malicious owner would be surprised an emergency drain bricks core functions -> operational hazard (Law 3), not a malicious-admin vector. Recoverable (no fund loss) caps it at Medium.
attackPath: During an active promo, the non-malicious owner invokes emergencyTransfer to drain balances (a plausible incident response).
Promo bookkeeping (promoToken/promoRewardBalance/promoPhase) is left set with no backing balance.
On unpause, _updatePool/_claimRewards promo math references the now-inconsistent state.
stake/withdraw/claim revert for all stakers with pending promo until the owner runs a non-obvious beginFlush -> batchClaim -> finalizePromotion recovery.
recommendation: Reset promo state (promoToken/promoRewardBalance/promoPhase) inside emergencyTransfer, or document that a promo must be finalized/flushed before invoking emergencyTransfer.
priorArtCrossRef: ledger C-02 / V2-C-01 (emergencyTransfer no-zeroing family; distinct root cause — promo-specific stale accounting)
specConformanceCrossRef: DEDUP-03b (pauseWithdraw post-drain revert = F-01/V2-F-01 false-recovery-promise class) compounds in the same function but is a DISTINCT root cause — do not double-count.
